description: This header file defines the interface for a string buffer utility in C, including functions for creating, destroying, appending strings, and retrieving the buffer contents.

methods.name: stringBufferCreate
methods.description: Creates a new StringBuffer with a specified initial size.

methods.name: stringBufferDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a StringBuffer and frees associated memory.

methods.name: stringBufferAppend
methods.description: Appends a full string to the buffer, copying the contents.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendLength
methods.description: Appends a specified length of a string to the buffer.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendWithComma
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer with an optional comma at the beginning or end.

methods.name: stringBufferLength
methods.description: Returns the current length of the buffer contents.

methods.name: stringBufferToString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a null-terminated string.
